company.name: ApexFlow Systems
company.vision: To eliminate multi-tier manufacturing supply chain stoppages through continuous graph intelligence and autonomous mitigation playbooks.

context.brief: ApexFlow is an Autonomous Supply Chain Resilience Operating System. Mid-market manufacturers managing $50M–$500M BOM spend suffer catastrophic line stoppages because Tier-2/3 raw material bottlenecks remain invisible until shipments are weeks overdue. ApexFlow connects directly to legacy ERPs (SAP, NetSuite) in 48 hours, continuously maps sub-tier supplier dependencies, and generates pre-vetted recovery playbooks with human-in-the-loop executive control.
context.target_customer: VPs of Supply Chain, Heads of Procurement, and Chief Operating Officers at mid-market precision manufacturing, industrial electronics, and medical device companies.
context.value_prop: Continuous sub-tier BOM risk observability and deterministic mitigation playbooks that prevent expensive production line shutdowns without requiring multi-year ERP migrations.

assumptions.statement: Mid-market manufacturing VPs will pay $50k+/year if we detect sub-tier shortages 14 days earlier.
Procurement directors will reject fully automated order dispatching without explicit human manager signoff.
Legacy ERP API connectors (SAP RFC, NetSuite RESTlet) can be deployed within 48 hours without engineering support.
Cold outbound email referencing specific sub-tier supplier bottlenecks will generate >8% demo booking rate.
Competitors like Project44 and SAP Ariba will be unable to replicate deep multi-tier graph simulations due to legacy schema lock-in.

constraints: Must maintain SOC2 Type II compliance standards for customer ERP telemetry.
All autonomous mitigation playbooks must require explicit human approval before external transmission.
Initial release targets North American and European industrial manufacturing corridors.
